changelog:
🚀 Major Release v2.0.0!

- ✨ Prompt Anywhere: Reshape text inline with custom prompts using '...instruction...'
- 💡 Did You Know?: New interactive discovery hub to learn hidden power features
- 📂 Custom API Profiles: Save and switch between multiple AI provider configurations
- ⚡ Trigger Anywhere: AI prompts, math, and snippets now work anywhere in the text
- 🛠 Local LLM Support: Added cleartext traffic support for local API endpoints
- 🎨 UI Revamp: Colorful home screen menus and polished animations
- 🐛 Bug Fixes: Improved status bar consistency and overlay stability
